notes:
2026-09-12: Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's synergy.json v2 unified schema), continuation of today's fin/1-37 rollout. NOT to be confused with ultima-origin-of-oblivion (fin/2, a Legendary Creature — God) — this is Ultima (fin/38), a plain Sorcery, {3}{W}{W}. Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #38): "Destroy all artifacts and creatures. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and \"this turn\" and \"until end of turn\" effects end.)" — a single continuous line in Scryfall's own oracle_text field (no \n between the two ability sentences and the reminder-text parenthetical for this specific card), so every oracle annotation uses line:0.

Dropped the old v1 id/sourceText/highlight fields and the FOUR controller-split facts (wipe-graveyard-you/opp, wipe-dies-you/opp) and TWO controller-split sink facts (wipe-needs-you/opp) in favor of unconstrained facts with no controller field, mirroring fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own real, identically-motivated collapse (this card's own oracle text also has no controller restriction — the wipe hits both players symmetrically). No presence-shaped SOURCE facts (per the standing rule) — self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}) and self-graveyard ({to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', subject:'self'}) mirror fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own self-cast/self-graveyard pair exactly (both typeLine-anchored on 'Sorcery', CR 608.2m).

'Destroy all artifacts and creatures' — a real UNCONDITIONAL, UNTARGETED (no 'target' at all — a real broadcast to every artifact/creature on the battlefield, CR 701.6) mass-destroy, genuinely different in kind from fate-of-the-sun-cryst's/summon-bahamut's own single/up-to-one TARGETED destroy. Modeled as the ACT-vs-CONSEQUENCE pair the design doc's standing rule calls for: destroy-act ({event:'destroy', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:false}) stays a bare ACT tag with no inline zoneFrom/zoneTo (CR 701.6 — indestructible/regeneration/protection can still save an individual permanent even inside a mass, unconditional wipe; the movement is conditional PER-PERMANENT even though the effect itself has no target to fizzle), plus a separate dies CONSEQUENCE ({event:'dies', from:'Battlefield', to:'Graveyard', target:{types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, targeted:false}) which DOES carry from/to inline (by the time a permanent actually dies, CR 700.4's battlefield->graveyard move is unconditionally guaranteed, same reasoning as every other dies-consequence fact in the pool). Neither carries subject (the things dying are a type-constrained bucket, not this card itself) or controller (no controller restriction in the real text). New sink fact ({to:'Battlefield', types:{hasAny:['Artifact','Creature']}}, no controller) mirrors fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own unconstrained-sink collapse — 'needs a real artifact or creature present on either side to actually destroy anything.'

'End the turn' — grepped turn.ts/engine.ts/state.ts/card.ts's own Actions interface for endTurn/Time Stop/cleanup-jump machinery before concluding anything: turn.ts's own PHASES/advancePhase only ever advance ONE step at a time in fixed order (no way for a card effect to jump straight to Cleanup), there is no Stack-exile primitive anywhere (the Stack is deliberately never modeled as an assignable zone value at all, per SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's own standing rule), and Cleanup's own real discard-to-maximum-hand-size (turn.ts line ~113) only ever fires as that phase's own automatic action, never as something a card effect can invoke directly mid-turn. Confirmed a genuine, honest documented engine gap — same 'real text only, no possible backing' treatment as Auron's Inspiration's broadcast pump — NOT modeled as a Fact (no engine execution exists to point at as evidence, and inventing one would fabricate trace evidence that can't exist). definition.ts's own pre-existing 'end the turn' custom Effect (a real no-op, already correctly documented before this task) is UNCHANGED — this task confirmed its reasoning is still accurate rather than needing a fix.

scenarios.ts migrated to the engine-trace pilot format (runEngineScenarios) — ONE real scenario (per the new 2026-09-12 standing default), a genuinely SYMMETRIC board: your own real Dragoon's Lance (Artifact) + Dwarven Castle Guard (Creature) + a Plains, and the opponent's own real Phoenix Down (Artifact) + Coeurl (Creature, same non-token permanent fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own scenario already uses) + a Plains. All 4 artifacts/creatures are real, non-token permanents (a token would log ceasesToExist instead of destroy, which can't back a real event:'destroy' ACT fact as trace evidence — same reasoning fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own scenario documents). Real trace confirms: 4 real fn:'destroy' lines (2 controller:'you', 2 controller:'opp0'), both real Plains untouched. 'End the turn' is not and cannot be exercised (no machinery).

Added 'ultima' to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS (scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs) and wrote annotations-authoring.json (5 facts). compute-annotations.mjs: 5 facts annotated (2 typeLine 'Sorcery' at 0-7, 3 oracle at line 0). compute-weights.mjs --slug=ultima: self-cast/self-graveyard/destroy-act -> value 1 (neutral, no measurable magnitude beyond one occurrence), dies -> value 5 (magnitude 4 real destroy/sacrifice count from the trace, bucketed). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped ultima: 0 hard failures, expected soft notes only — 4 bystander 'enters' + 5 'tapForMana'; full pool 315 v2 cards: 12 pre-existing hard failures, ALL on OTHER cards currently mid-edit by concurrent sibling sessions on this same fin/1-37 rollout, confirmed via git status showing those exact files as uncommitted-modified — none caused by or related to this task's own changes). npx vitest run functional-model: 238/238 (unchanged). annotation-coverage.test.ts: 5/5. scenario-card-names.mjs: 0 violations (all real Scryfall names).

Real find-synergies.mjs diff, isolated via an old(v1)/new(v2) synergy.json swap (not a stale git-HEAD diff — the pool has many other concurrent uncommitted migrations in flight from sibling sessions right now, confirmed via git status, so a HEAD-based diff couldn't isolate just this card's own change): 34 old lines -> 22 new lines for this card's own edges (net -12, fully accounted for, no surprises):
- Lost 9 duplicate 'graveyard presence' lines (the old wipe-graveyard-you controller='you' fact was fully redundant with self-graveyard — both unconstrained, controller='you' — collapsing them removes double-counting the SAME 9 real cards self-graveyard already matches once; wipe-graveyard-opp/controller='opp' matched 0 real cards in the old file, so no loss there).
- Lost 12 real EventFact-shaped 'dying' lines (Aerith Gainsborough, Dwarven Castle Guard, Judge Magister Gabranth x2, Magic Pot, Sephiroth Fabled SOLDIER x2, Sephiroth Planet's Heir, Undercity Dire Rat, Vincent Valentine, Zodiark Umbral God x2) — the old wipe-dies-you/opp facts were pure EventFacts (no zone data); the new merged dies fact carries real from/to, so per the pool's own standing 'a merged fact classifies zone-shaped ONLY' rule (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md, summon-bahamut precedent) it no longer satisfies these real event-shaped sinks. Same accepted, already-precedented shape-family regression, not a new one.
- Gained 9 real zone-shaped Graveyard-presence lines (Cantankerous Keepers, Eden Seat of the Sanctum, Emet-Selch Unsundered, Ignis Scientia, Magic Pot, Qutrub Forayer, Rydia's Return, Thranduil Sindarin Liege, Vanille Cheerful l'Cie) — the EXACT SAME 9 cards named in summon-bahamut's own SYNERGY_DESIGN.md writeup as the real unconstrained zone-shaped sinks a merged dies fact newly reaches; confirms the new dies fact's from/to data is doing real, correctly-classified work.
- Sink side (this card's own want for battlefield artifact/creature presence): 0 net change — the old two controller-split sink facts and the new single unconstrained one already matched the identical real producer set pool-wide, same as fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own sink collapse.
- self-cast (genuinely NEW fact, didn't exist in v1 at all): 0 new matches — no pool sink wants a bare 'cast a spell' from a Sorcery, and no self-interaction triggers (unlike summon-bahamut's cast/enters pair, this card has no other fact shaped to self-interact with it).
knownGaps: "End the turn" (exile the stack, discard down to maximum hand size, damage/until-end-of-turn effects end) has no Fact/engine vocabulary — confirmed via grep of turn.ts/engine.ts/state.ts/card.ts's Actions interface that no turn-ending-mid-turn or Stack-exile machinery exists anywhere in this model; definition.ts's own 'end the turn' custom Effect is an honest, documented no-op, same treatment as Auron's Inspiration's broadcast pump.
